catalogue.title: Request catalogue
catalogue.description: Choose the request you want to submit. Only the requests you are allowed to submit are listed.
catalogue.empty: There are no requests you can submit yet.

wizard.reviewHint: Check the values below, then submit. You can go back to any step to change them.
wizard.returnedHint: This request was returned to you. Correct it and resubmit.
wizard.notEditable: This request can no longer be edited.
wizard.aiTitle: Fill the form from a document
wizard.aiHint: Upload a document: AI proposes values for the form. Nothing is saved until you review the values and save.
wizard.aiDone_one: AI proposed {{count}} value — review it before saving
wizard.aiDone_other: AI proposed {{count}} values — review them before saving
wizard.aiNone: AI found no values for this form in the document.
wizard.aiReview: Some values were proposed by AI. Accept or edit each one before saving or submitting.
wizard.embedDoneHint: You will be notified when it moves on. You can follow it under My requests.

mine.title: My requests
mine.description: Requests you created. Returned requests come first.
mine.empty: You have not created any request yet.

queue.title: Processing queue
queue.description: Requests waiting at the stages you process, soonest due first.
queue.selectAll: Select all requests on this page
queue.bulkHint: Only requests whose completion needs no form are completed; the others are listed with the reason.

failures.requests_bulk_notSafe: needs the completion form — open the request

request.cancelHint: The request stops here. This cannot be undone.

decide.noDuplicates: No overlapping document found among {{count}} compared.

types.title: Request types
types.description: Built-in request types of the systems and the custom types built here, with their links for the intranet.
types.name: Type

general.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; cannot change later.
general.prefixHint: Upper-case letters and digits, used in request numbers ({TYPE}).
general.owningUnitHint: Empty: the owning unit of the system.

form.system: Defined by the system: cannot be removed or retyped
form.titleOfHint: The value becomes the request's title in that language.
form.requestUnitHint: Approvers are resolved from this unit instead of the requester's.

condition.noEarlier: No earlier field to depend on

preview.hint: The form as requesters see it. Try values to check the conditions; nothing is saved.

stages.approvalHint: Default approver: the requests office; one step, 24 working hours.
stages.chain: The approval chain (steps, approvers, conditions, SLA) is edited in
stages.processingHint: Processors complete the request, optionally with a completion form.
stages.processorsHint: None selected: the requests office processes.
stages.completionFormHint: Fields the processor fills when completing.
stages.allowReturn: Processors may return the request to the requester
stages.builtInHint: The stages of a built-in type are defined by its system: you can rename them and set the SLA and processor roles.

templates.mergeHint: Write the template in HTML. Values are inserted with these fields and are always escaped.

errors.code: Use a letter first, then letters, digits or underscores (50 at most), unique in the form.
errors.duplicateCode: Another field already uses this code.
errors.label: Give the field a label in Arabic or English.
errors.fieldOptions: Check the length, decimals and minimum / maximum of this field.
errors.tableColumns: A table needs 1 to 20 columns and valid minimum / maximum rows.
errors.condition: The condition must refer to an earlier field with a valid operator.
errors.tooManyFields: A form can have at most {{max}} fields.
errors.unknownField: This field is not part of the form.
errors.type: The value has the wrong type.
errors.range: The value is outside the allowed range.
errors.record: Choose a record you are allowed to see.
errors.file: The file is not attached to this request.
errors.typeInactive: This request type is no longer active.
errors.notAllowed: This is not possible at the request's current stage.
errors.actionUnavailable: This action is not available now.
errors.approveFormRequired: Fill in the approval form before approving.
errors.bulkNotSafe: This request needs its completion form; complete it from the request page.
errors.typeCode: Use 2–41 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
errors.typeCodeTaken: Another request type already uses this code.
errors.prefix: Use up to 10 upper-case letters or digits, starting with a letter.
errors.systemField: A field defined by the system cannot be removed or retyped ({{field}}).
errors.template: Check the template's code, audience and length.
errors.noStage: Keep at least the approval or the processing stage.
errors.sla: The SLA must be between 1 and 2000 working hours.
